Dozee is the pioneer in contactless, continuous remote patient monitoring (RPM) in hospitals & at home, delivering unparalleled patient safety and higher utilization rates across ICU beds. Their AI algorithms track the patient's vitals trends and generate an Early Warning Score enabling early detection of health deterioration for timely medical intervention. Dozee's non-invasive vital monitoring device provides personalized and adaptive solutions enabling proactive and cost effective healthcare solutions that can be directly be attributed to better control over user health.
